Nora (PM): Quick thread to align on burst-credit economics + GA gating for Reserved Pools. Sales wants a clear commitable promise around short bursts and an ops-safe fallback. Need decisions on credit sizing, carryover, and which customer asks are tabled to post-GA.

Ethan (Eng-Platform): Summary of our proposal: token-bucket per tenant, bucket refill based on committed QPS, max burst window 300s, carryover cap 10% of daily allowance. Fallback default = route_to_quantized -> smaller_model -> queue (100ms).

Priya (Customer Success): Pilots want a simple SLA line: "X concurrent requests guaranteed for Y minutes." They'll ask for visibility in Console: credits remaining + last fallback reason. If we promise SLA we need credits/credits-refund behavior defined.

Luca (Eng-SRE): Ops perspective: if we guarantee bursts we must include emergency preempt policy and an incident runbook. Also suggest we track two new metrics: burst_credit_usage_rate and fallback_long_running (>2m). Those feed alerts.

Nora (PM): Good. Decision points: 1) exact carryover percent (5% vs 10%), 2) whether prewarm micro-pools are allowed (cost), 3) if SLA includes a small financial credit or only operational remediation.

Ethan (Eng-Platform): Technical tradeoffs: prewarm reduces tail but increases cost and complexity. For MVP avoid prewarm. Carryover at 10% smooths usage without much risk. SLA crediting is legal/sales decision but ops prefers non-financial remediation initially.

Ana (Legal): For contracts: we can offer a conservative SLA that promises burst availability description and credits capped at N months of committed spend. But for MVP recommend operational credit (support priority + root cause) to avoid exposure. We can revisit paid credits after pilot success.

Priya (Customer Success): Pilots will accept operational credits if we provide strong console visibility + immediate CS escalation button. I can push one pilot to accept MVP but need the banner/notify.

Luca (Eng-SRE): Implementation notes: token-bucket refill formula = commit_qps * burst_window_s. Example: commit_qps=10 -> bucket = 10*300=3000 tokens; carryover max = 300 tokens (10%). Also enforce per-tenant max_replicas = commit_base * 3.

Ethan (Eng-Platform): Autoscale defaults for docs (example): {"policy":"reserve-mvp","scale_up_pct":0.8,"scale_down_pct":0.35,"min_replicas":2,"max_multiplier":3,"burst_window_s":300,"carryover_pct":10,"fallback_queue_ms":100}. Will include in PR.

Nora (PM): Prioritization: MUST = token-bucket, fallback routing, headroom + fallback telemetry, legal fallback clause draft. SHOULD = console banner + email notify for sustained fallback. MAYBE = prewarm micro-pools, per-route opt-outs.

Ana (Legal): I'll draft fallback clause that allows routing to degraded variants and requires notification. Include opt-out language and recommend a default opt-in for pilots with explicit UI consent.

Priya (Customer Success): If we don't ship banner for MVP I risk one pilot pausing. Can we move banner to SHOULD->MUST for pilots only? Maybe a pilot flag gating it.

Luca (Eng-SRE): We can enable banner for pilot tenants behind a feature-flag; that keeps MVP rollout simple while satisfying pilots. We'll need a flag gating and test coverage.

Ethan (Eng-Platform): PR plan: autoscale + token-bucket impl + telemetry schema + feature-flag for pilot-banner. I'll open PR by Thu. Need SRE to add alerts and chaos test.

Luca (Eng-SRE): I'll add synthetic 5m burst test and preemption scenario to the chaos checklist. Also add fallback.reason tag to traces.

Nora (PM): GA gates proposal: all MUSTs complete, 2 pilot signoffs, legal clause agreed, and 48h of stable pilot telemetry (fallback rate <2%). Rollout: internal canary 1% -> pilot 10% -> pilot expansion -> GA.

Priya (Customer Success): I'll collect pilot redlines today and confirm if they accept operational credits. If not, we'll escalate to Sales+Legal.

Ana (Legal): Will share a conservative clause draft by EOD. Recommend we avoid financial SLAs for first GA.

Ethan (Eng-Platform): Quick question: do we want to expose carryover_pct as editable per-tenant post-GA? Feels like a post-GA product decision.

Nora (PM): Post-GA feature: expose carryover and quota edit. Not in MVP.
